title: Forgetting scalars commutes with the constant-sheaf adjoint transition
statement: Let $Z,W$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $g:W\to Z$, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $M$ a $\Lambda$-module [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $V:\Lambda\text{-Mod}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ for forgetting scalars [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $M_T$ and $(VM)_T$ for the constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], $g^*$ for inverse image with unit $\eta_g$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $g_*$ for direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Assume $V$ preserves sheafification on both sites. Let $e_T:V(M_T)\to(VM)_T$ be the canonical constantCommuteCompose comparison and let $a_g^M:g^*M_Z\to M_W$ and $a_g^{VM}:g^*(VM)_Z\to(VM)_W$ be the canonical constant-sheaf pullback comparisons. Then $g_*(e_W)\circ V(g_*(a_g^M)\circ\eta_g)=g_*(a_g^{VM})\circ\eta_g\circ e_Z$ as morphisms from $V(M_Z)$ to $g_*((VM)_W)$, with the definitional identification of forgetting scalars and direct image.

proof.text: For either module or abelian coefficients, the unit equation for the canonical constant pullback comparison sends a sheafification generator at the terminal object to the equal-valued generator after base change. Naturality along the unique map to the terminal object gives this equality at every etale object, as in the defining adjoint comparison [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant].

The coefficient comparison preserves generators by Mathlib constantCommuteCompose_hom_app_hom, sheafComposeIso_inv_fac and naturality of toSheafify. Thus the two composites agree on every generator. Since coefficient forgetting preserves sheafification, precompose by the inverse coefficient comparison and use the sheafification universal property [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] to conclude equality of sheaf morphisms. This uses one scheme morphism only, without any composition comparison or section coefficient equivalence.

theorem constantModuleTransition_coefficients
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (g : W ⟶ Z)
    [Z.smallEtaleTopology.PreservesSheafification
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [W.smallEtaleTopology.PreservesSheafification
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})] :
    let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    (sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology V).map
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).unit.app _ ≫
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).map
            ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).hom.app M)) ≫
      (lowerStar A g).map ((constantCommuteCompose W.smallEtaleTopology V).hom.app M) =
    (constantCommuteCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology V).hom.app M ≫
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g).unit.app _ ≫
      (lowerStar A g).map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso A g).hom.app (V.obj M))
